svg.text: Drone survey: flight plan and conditions
Flight lines over a corridor (A), photo overlap (B) and sun angle (C). Not to scale.
A · Plan view: parallel flight lines over the corridor
ground targets on land or emergent reef (4–5),
lines planned with the drone's mission app;
spacing set for ≥80% side overlap over water
B · Side view: altitude and photo overlap
overlap of consecutive photos: ≥80% over water
C · When to fly: sun angle and tide
low sun: glint away from camera
reef flat, seagrass and mangrove fringe
as shallow or exposed as possible
ripples and waves blur the bottom
Early morning or late afternoon is usually best.
